instruction_text: Speak directly to one listener with warmth and a smile in your voice; calm, steady and reassuring, like a favorite morning radio host, while keeping the news clear and credible.
asr_text: Having to pay for redelivery just doesn't feel right to me. My husband and I are both away at work, so when we can choose a delivery time, we choose a day and time when we know we'll be home. But once I chose a morning time and the package did not come. I went out to do an errand. When I came back, there was a note saying they had tried to deliver it. There are also many packages where we cannot choose a time. We do not know when they will come either. Before they charge us, I want them to fix two things: come at the time we chose and tell us when the package will arrive. Delivery workers must have a hard time because there are not enough of them. I guess it can't be helped, but I can't accept having to pay for that. Am I wrong to feel this way?
